rows.note: This is the all-purpose affirmative, including agreement and affirming the positive correction of a negative statement.

example.english: Are you free tomorrow? yes, I am.
example.jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 dak1 haan4 maa3 hai6 dak1 haan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose exclamation of pleasure or approval, especially after something good happens.

example.jyutping: kau4 deoi6 jap6 bo1 laa3 hou2 je5

rows.note: Use this punchy exclamation when approving of something as excellent or impressive.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for an explicit affirmative answer.

example.english: They gave a definite yes, so everyone was relieved.
example.traditional: 佢畀咗個肯定嘅答案，大家就放心喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 zo2 go3 hang2 ding6 ge3 daap3 on3 daai6 gaa1 zau6 fong3 sam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the yes specifically means agreement, consent, or acceptance rather than just an affirmative answer.

example.english: I said yes to going with you to see the doctor.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 jing3 pui4 nei5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use this in an adversative correction meaning “no, rather...” when rejecting a negative statement and asserting the opposite.

example.english: You don't like this film? No—rather, yes, I really like it.
example.traditional: 你唔係唔鍾意呢套戲呀？唔，我好鍾意。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hai6 m4 zung1 ji3 ni1 tou3 hei3 aa3 m4 ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3
